newsitem.title: RUSSIA: Six die in suspected gas blast in central Russia.
newsitem.headline: Six die in suspected gas blast in central Russia.

text.p: Five women and a 10-year-old boy were killed when a suspected gas explosion tore apart an apartment block in the central Russian region of Tatarstan, a local governemnt spokesman said on Saturday.
Nine other people were taken to hospital after the blast on Friday in the two-storey block of eight apartments in the small town of Kukmor, about 120 km (75 miles) east of the Tatar capital Kazan.
"The whole building was destroyed," the spokesman for the Tatar government said by telephone from Kazan, which is about 750 km (500 miles) east of Moscow.
"Preliminary investigations show the most likely cause was a leak from a gas cylinder used in the central heating," he said.
